notes.content:

notes.title: Update 0.3.10
notes.content:
Hey there, it is Wednesday, everyfroggy!

We have come to the last of the spawn shape updates. The final chapters to get the new spawn shapes are the chapters in the storyline about Kermit and the storyline about Ribbit. We also managed to eat some bugs, you can read about it below.

Changes:

 New spawn shapes have been added to Kermit's storyline, starting with the chapter "That sound"
 New spawn shapes have been added to the chapter "Kermit went further!"
 New spawn shapes have been added to Ribbit's storyline, starting with the chapter "The unwanted frog"
 New spawn shapes have been added to the chapter "Toxic truth"
 Corrected the description on the chapter "At last" to use past tense

Bug fixes:

 After fixing the bug with the pixel font (Thintel) disappearing (only on Mac) the text stopped appearing pixel perfect (on both Mac and Windows!) in some cases, that has now been fixed
 Froin symbol fixed to appear pixel perfect at all times (hopefully)

About upcoming updates
We have been thinking about what to update next and came to the decision to have some more time between the updates. We will from now on do one update a month, of course it will still be on a Wednesday!

You might remember that we took the same decision once before and the reason for having more time between the updates is once again the same, it will give us time to work on bigger things. We will continue to push smaller updates once a month and because of that we hope to be able to work a lot on the big graphics update that will make it possible for us to add new environments.

If a month is way too long without any Froguelike updates you are very welcome to join our Discord server. There you can ask us how the updates are coming along, give us feedback and suggestions, report bugs and look at frog memes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767954/900bc7a2a811c3bf4c1af78c5a659c4a674820ed.png

notes.title: Update notes for 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hej hej! It is Wednesday, mina grodor!

When some items reach their max level they get better the more bugs you have eaten in the current chapter, in this update we change that to being based on the bugs you ate during the whole run!
With this we also changed the numbers a bit, the item stat increase is a bit lower for each eaten bug but in the end it has the potential to be much stronger than before since it is based on the total amount of eaten bugs.

Please let us know what you think about this change! :)

 Items that scale with score (bugs eaten) on their top level now scale based on the total score instead of each chapters score
 The score in the top right is now displaying the runs total score instead of the chapters score

The last two weeks we have also been working on updating the environment graphics. One thing we want to do is to make the frog swim in the water, here is a preview of how it is looking so far (keep in mind that it is not implemented in the game yet and it is still being worked on).

notes.content:

There were also some bugs eaten and other changes, read it all in the list below!

 After an item has been found in a chapter the compass arrows now show what they lead to

Best of hops to you all, and see you again in two weeks!

notes.title: Update notes for 0.1.34
notes.content:
Hey there all frog enjoyers, it's Wednesday!

This week we are adding options for changing the font in Froguelike, so in case you find the pixel art font (Thintel) difficult to read you can now choose to change the font to Liberation Sans or OpenDyslexic. We also rearranged the settings screen and sorted different settings into different tabs in the book. You will find the font settings under "Accessibility".

Since the two new fonts aren't pixel perfect they will look blurry if you play the game in a low resolution, so if you have problems with the text being blurry try out a bigger resolution under the "Display" settings, thank you!

We weren't able to make this affect the damage texts yet, they will still use the font Thintel no mater what font you choose in the settings.

This change was made thanks to a suggestion over on our Discord server, if you also have suggestions you can join and share them on Discord or here in the Steam forums :)

New:

 Two new options for fonts in the game
 Added credits for the OpenDyslexic font

Changes:

 Rearranged the settings screen
 Edited some text boxes to make sure all text fits in all three fonts

Johanna & Rémi

notes.title: Update notes for 0.1.33
notes.content:
Froggy Wednesday to you all! 
It is time for another Froguelike update, and to not miss out - make sure you turn on the music!

It is finally time to replace the music in Froguelike. The old music was left since the first version of our game, when it was made as part of a 5 day long game jam in October 2022. That piece of music is only 20 seconds long, so it was getting quite repetitive by now and I understand if a lot of you turned the music down in the settings. Now it is time to turn the music back on!

The new music is made by Brian Diamond and we are very excited to hear what you think about it!

Sometime in the future I will work more on the implementation of the music, right now the tension of the music is simply based on how many bugs and plants are still n the run and I think it could be improved by taking bug tiers and types into account when figuring out which of the musics 3 intensity versions should be played. That's for future Johanna to tinker with, right now we are at least happy to present you with some new (and longer haha) music.

Let us know what you think about it here in the Steam forums or hop on into our Discord server!

New:

 All music in the game has been replaced with new music by Brian Diamond
 Some new names in the credits

Changes:

 Changed the text on the EA disclaimer slightly since the dynamic music is now added

Bug fixes:

 The music is no longer restarted when going back from character selection

Johanna & Rémi

For this week we have a whole buffet of balancing changes, and it is more important than ever to eat as many bugs as you can!

New:

 Almost all passive, in run, items now scale with score when upgrading the item to its max level (the score is the amount of eaten bugs in the current chapter, the number that is shown next to the small fly in the top-right corner of the screen)

Changes:

 Less XP needed to level up for higher levels
 Passive health recovery is now active at all times
 Plaster in the shop is less powerful
 Plaster as a run item is more powerful
 Curse tongue gets a damage boost every level-up but its curse chance never decreases. The curse is still active even at the tongues max level
 Now the curse is active for either all or none of the enemies hit by the tongue
 Instead of writing "level max" when upgrading an item or a tongue in a run it now says either "level 5" or "level 10", still in red color as before
 The froggy grail is now maxed out at level 5 instead of level 3 (in a run), it now gives a total of 5 revives instead of 4
 Vampire tongue gives less health overall (always ~5% of inflicted damage) and it doesn't increase with level-up
 Vampire tongues get bigger and cover more area at higher level
 Rotatongue now damages close bugs too (the whole tongue is now dealing damage instead of just the tip), it also has a slightly stronger knock back effect
 Poison damage now stacks! If you inflict poison to a bug that is already poisoned, the poison damage increases
 Poison tongue is now cone-shaped and therefore it covers a bigger area
 Upgrading the poison tongue will no longer give you more poison tongues
 Poison tongue damage increases more when leveling up, 
 Poison damage is now affected by tongue damage boosts from the Mighty shop item and in run item
 Plants are easier to eat and give more XP

Bug fix:

 Fixed a bug where bounties would ignore damage taken

We also wanted to make the end-game more interesting by scaling your stats with score, giving you a good motivation to eat those bugs even after you level up to the max!
But most of all, we wanted to improve some of the tongues and items that were underused, such as the rotatongue, the poison tongue, and the plaster.

We hope that you enjoy it!

notes.title: Development plans for Froguelike
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767954/ea5bd618621918732e7b3957c0ffb3c99ad9bec2.png

Hello all frog likers!
We are working hard on fixing bugs and improving Froguelike, on top of that we are also working on new features and updates.

In this post we will give you an overview of what’s to come. However, we will not talk about exactly when anything will be released. Making a game is difficult and it often takes longer than expected, so to not make promises we can't keep and to not put too much pressure on ourselves we will not say much about timeframes.

So in no specific order, other than the order I thought of them in, here is what we have planned:

 A new feature: Power ups

 These can be found in the chapter while playing, if you catch them something happens. We are making a variety of different power ups and if they will help you or not depend on your play style and on your frogs strengths and weaknesses.

 More stories

 There are some frogs that do not have their own stories yet, but they all sure have a story to tell. We are working on writing stories for all the frogs and we are adding more freestanding chapters that are not part of a story. On top of that we want to go through existing stories and try to make it easier to follow them.

 New music and more sounds

 We are replacing the 20 second loop of music that is currently in the game with dynamic music. The new music is going to be more intense if there are more bugs on the screen. Along with new music we will also rework some existing sounds, we will add more sounds where it is missing and add ambience sound for the bugs and the environment. 

 A new feature: A branching system for when you level up

 Right now leveling up is very straightforward and we have plans to change that. We are imagining a system where your upcoming choices change depending on what items and tongues you have picked. With this also comes the ability to combine items and tongues into new exciting things.

 More tongues and items

 We think that the branching system will bring many new tongues and items to the game, we will see where that takes us. Our hope is that it gives room for a lot of different, silly and new types of tongues and items, who said that all tongues have to be attached to your frog?

 A rework of the map generation

 We want to make each chapter more interesting by improving the map, we are planning to both improve the placement of obstacles and the graphics. Right now the ground is a bit too busy and we wish to have bigger areas of water. We are excited to see where experimenting with how to generate the map will lead us. We are also making plans for a new type of environment.

 More frogs

 We want to introduce more playable characters along with their stories and unique starting stats.

We sure are excited for what’s to come, and we hope you are too!
Feel free to reach out to us if you have silly ideas, crazy wishes or any type of suggestion of how to make the game better and more fun. Talk to us in the Steam forums or over at our Discord server.

Now we will hop back to munching on bugs and working on upcoming updates!
Johanna and Rémi
